questions.q: A number decreased by 9 equals 34. Find the number.
questions.answer: $x-9=34\Rightarrow x=43$.

questions.q: Three times a number, minus 7, equals 32. Find the number.
questions.answer: $3x-7=32\Rightarrow3x=39\Rightarrow x=13$.

questions.q: The sum of two numbers is 58. One number is 12 more than the other. Find both numbers.
questions.answer: Let the smaller be $x$: $x+(x+12)=58\Rightarrow2x=46\Rightarrow x=23$. The numbers are $23$ and $35$.

questions.q: A two-digit number has digit sum 11. Reversing its digits gives a number 45 more than the original. Find the original number.
questions.answer: Let the digits be $t$ (tens) and $u$ (units): $t+u=11$ and $(10u+t)-(10t+u)=45\Rightarrow u-t=5$. Solving together: $u=8$, $t=3$. The original number is $38$.

questions.q: A father is 4 times as old as his daughter. In 5 years, he will be 3 times as old as she will be. Find their current ages.
questions.answer: Let the daughter be $x$, father $4x$: $4x+5=3(x+5)\Rightarrow4x+5=3x+15\Rightarrow x=10$. Daughter is $10$, father is $40$.

questions.q: Sara is twice as old as her brother. In 6 years, the sum of their ages will be 42. Find their current ages.
questions.answer: Let the brother be $x$, Sara $2x$: $(x+6)+(2x+6)=42\Rightarrow3x=24\Rightarrow x=10$. Brother is $10$, Sara is $20$.

questions.q: Ahmed is 5 years older than Salem. Seven years ago, Ahmed was twice as old as Salem. Find their current ages.
questions.answer: Let Salem be $x$, Ahmed $x+5$: $(x+5-7)=2(x-7)\Rightarrow x-2=2x-14\Rightarrow x=12$. Salem is $12$, Ahmed is $17$.

questions.q: The sum of a mother's and daughter's ages is 50. The mother is 20 years older than the daughter. Find both ages.
questions.answer: Let the daughter be $d$: $d+(d+20)=50\Rightarrow2d=30\Rightarrow d=15$. Daughter is $15$, mother is $35$.

questions.q: A train travels 180 km in 2 hours. At the same speed, how far does it travel in 5 hours?
questions.answer: Speed $=180\div2=90$ km/h. Distance $=90\times5=450$ km.

questions.q: Two cities are 350 km apart. A car leaves one city for the other at 70 km/h. How long does the trip take?
questions.answer: Time $=350\div70=5$ hours.

questions.q: Two cyclists start at the same point and ride in opposite directions, at 15 km/h and 20 km/h. After how many hours will they be 105 km apart?
questions.answer: Combined speed $=15+20=35$ km/h. Time $=105\div35=3$ hours.

questions.q: A plane flies against a headwind at 480 km/h and covers 1,440 km. How many hours does the flight take?
questions.answer: Time $=1{,}440\div480=3$ hours.

questions.q: Worker A can paint a room in 6 hours; Worker B can paint the same room in 3 hours. Working together, how long will it take them?
questions.answer: Combined rate $=\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{3}=\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{2}{6}=\dfrac{3}{6}=\dfrac{1}{2}$ room/hour. Time $=2$ hours.

questions.q: A pipe fills a tank in 10 hours; a second pipe fills it in 15 hours. Working together, how long to fill the tank?
questions.answer: Combined rate $=\dfrac{1}{10}+\dfrac{1}{15}=\dfrac{3}{30}+\dfrac{2}{30}=\dfrac{5}{30}=\dfrac{1}{6}$. Time $=6$ hours.

questions.q: 6 workers can complete a job in 8 days. How many days would 4 workers take, at the same rate?
questions.answer: Total work $=6\times8=48$ worker-days. With $4$ workers: $48\div4=12$ days.

questions.q: A pipe fills a tank in 12 hours, but a leak can empty a full tank in 24 hours. If both act at once, how long to fill the tank?
questions.answer: Net rate $=\dfrac{1}{12}-\dfrac{1}{24}=\dfrac{2}{24}-\dfrac{1}{24}=\dfrac{1}{24}$. Time $=24$ hours.

questions.q: A jeweler mixes gold worth 200 riyals/gram with silver worth 50 riyals/gram to make 10 grams of a mixture worth 110 riyals/gram. How many grams of gold are used?
questions.answer: Let $g$ be grams of gold: $200g+50(10-g)=110\times10\Rightarrow150g=600\Rightarrow g=4$ grams.

questions.q: A shopkeeper has 15 riyals in 1-riyal and 2-riyal coins, 10 coins in total. How many of each coin does she have?
questions.answer: Let $x$ be 1-riyal coins, $y$ be 2-riyal coins: $x+y=10$, $x+2y=15$. Subtracting: $y=5$, $x=5$.

questions.q: A solution is $40\%$ acid. How many liters of pure water must be added to 20 liters of this solution to dilute it to $25\%$ acid?
questions.answer: Acid amount stays $0.4\times20=8$ liters. $\dfrac{8}{20+w}=0.25\Rightarrow20+w=32\Rightarrow w=12$ liters.

questions.q: Event tickets cost 30 riyals for adults and 18 riyals for children. 150 tickets were sold for 3,780 riyals in total. How many adult tickets were sold?
questions.answer: Let $a$ be adults, so $150-a$ children: $30a+18(150-a)=3{,}780\Rightarrow12a=1{,}080\Rightarrow a=90$ adult tickets.

questions.q: Ali, Basim and Khalid have 36 books together. Ali has twice as many as Basim, and Khalid has 6 more than Ali. Find how many books each has.
questions.answer: Let Basim $=x$, Ali $=2x$, Khalid $=2x+6$: $x+2x+2x+6=36\Rightarrow5x=30\Rightarrow x=6$. Basim has $6$, Ali has $12$, Khalid has $18$.

questions.q: A number between 50 and 70 is divisible by both 3 and 4, but not by 8. Find the number.
questions.answer: Multiples of $12$ between $50$ and $70$: only $60$. Is $60$ divisible by $8$? $60\div8=7.5$, no. The number is $60$.

questions.q: In a class, every student plays football or basketball (or both). 25 play football, 18 play basketball, and 10 play both. How many students are in the class?
questions.answer: By inclusion-exclusion: $25+18-10=33$ students.

questions.q: Four consecutive even integers sum to 92. Find the largest one.
questions.answer: Let the integers be $n,n+2,n+4,n+6$: $4n+12=92\Rightarrow n=20$. The largest is $26$.

questions.q: After spending half his money on a book, then 20 riyals on lunch, Yousef has 30 riyals left. How much did he start with?
questions.answer: Let the start be $x$: $\dfrac{x}{2}-20=30\Rightarrow\dfrac{x}{2}=50\Rightarrow x=100$ riyals.

questions.q: A number is tripled, then 8 is subtracted, giving 25. Find the original number.
questions.answer: $3x-8=25\Rightarrow3x=33\Rightarrow x=11$.

questions.q: After a $15\%$ pay cut, an employee's salary is 3,400 riyals. Find the salary before the cut.
questions.answer: Original $\times0.85=3{,}400\Rightarrow$ original $=3{,}400\div0.85=4{,}000$ riyals.

questions.q: A water tank is $\dfrac{1}{4}$ full. After adding 60 liters, it becomes $\dfrac{5}{8}$ full. Find the tank's total capacity.
questions.answer: $60=C\left(\dfrac{5}{8}-\dfrac{1}{4}\right)=C\left(\dfrac{3}{8}\right)\Rightarrow C=60\times\dfrac{8}{3}=160$ liters.

questions.q: A rectangular field is twice as long as it is wide, and its perimeter is 90 m. Find its length and width.
questions.answer: Let width $=w$, length $=2w$: $2(w+2w)=90\Rightarrow6w=90\Rightarrow w=15$ m. Length $=30$ m.

questions.q: Layla buys 3 notebooks and 2 pens for 29 riyals. Fahad buys 1 notebook and 4 pens for 23 riyals, at the same prices. Find the price of one notebook and one pen.
questions.answer: Let $n$ be the notebook price, $p$ the pen price: $3n+2p=29$, $n+4p=23\Rightarrow n=23-4p$. Substituting: $3(23-4p)+2p=29\Rightarrow-10p=-40\Rightarrow p=4$, $n=7$. Notebook: $7$ riyals, pen: $4$ riyals.

questions.q: A car rental costs 80 riyals per day plus 0.50 riyals per km driven. A 3-day rental cost 435 riyals in total. How many km were driven?
questions.answer: $80\times3+0.5k=435\Rightarrow240+0.5k=435\Rightarrow0.5k=195\Rightarrow k=390$ km.

questions.q: The sum of three consecutive odd integers is 63. Find the integers.
questions.answer: Let the smallest be $n$: $n+(n+2)+(n+4)=63\Rightarrow3n+6=63\Rightarrow n=19$. The integers are $19,21,23$.

questions.q: A shop sells notebooks for 6 riyals each, with a "buy 3, get 1 free" offer. Layla needs 20 notebooks. How much will she pay?
questions.answer: Every group of 4 notebooks costs for 3: $20\div4=5$ groups, each costing $3\times6=18$ riyals. Total $=5\times18=90$ riyals.

questions.q: The sum of a number and its square is 42. Find the positive value of the number.
questions.answer: $x+x^2=42\Rightarrow x^2+x-42=0\Rightarrow(x+7)(x-6)=0$. The positive value is $x=6$.

questions.q: A number's triple exceeds its double by 15. Find the number.
questions.answer: $3x=2x+15\Rightarrow x=15$.

questions.q: In 10 years, Noura will be 3 times as old as she was 2 years ago. Find her current age.
questions.answer: Let her current age be $x$: $x+10=3(x-2)\Rightarrow x+10=3x-6\Rightarrow16=2x\Rightarrow x=8$.

questions.q: The sum of two consecutive multiples of 5 is 75. Find the larger one.
questions.answer: Let the numbers be $5k$ and $5k+5$: $10k+5=75\Rightarrow k=7$. The numbers are $35$ and $40$; the larger is $40$.

questions.q: A photocopier prints 45 pages per minute. How many minutes does it take to print 810 pages?
questions.answer: $810\div45=18$ minutes.

questions.q: A recipe for 6 people uses 450 g of rice. How much rice is needed for 15 people, at the same rate per person?
questions.answer: Rice per person $=450\div6=75$ g. For $15$ people: $15\times75=1{,}125$ g.

questions.q: A factory produces 1,200 items in 8 hours. At the same rate, how many items would it produce in a 10-hour shift?
questions.answer: Rate $=1{,}200\div8=150$ items/hour. In $10$ hours: $10\times150=1{,}500$ items.

questions.q: Three taps together fill a pool in 4 hours. Two of the taps alone would take 6 hours. How long would the third tap alone take to fill the pool?
questions.answer: Combined rate $=\dfrac{1}{4}$. Two-tap rate $=\dfrac{1}{6}$. Third tap rate $=\dfrac{1}{4}-\dfrac{1}{6}=\dfrac{3}{12}-\dfrac{2}{12}=\dfrac{1}{12}$, so it alone takes $12$ hours.
